guessCharacter.title: Guess the Character
guessCharacter.rules: One player secretly picks a Bible character, the other guesses with yes/no questions. The game answers from a table of facts, so nobody can slip or cheat. There are 10 attempts: every question and every wrong guess uses one. The fewer attempts, the more points. A match has 4 rounds and the roles swap each round.
guessCharacter.answersNote: Answers follow the text of the Bible: if Scripture does not mention something, the answer is “No”. “Unknown from the Bible” means there is no clear answer.
guessCharacter.level1Desc: Only the best-known characters. There is a hint: a list of who still fits the answers.
guessCharacter.level3Desc: Every character, including lesser-known ones. No hint.
guessCharacter.peerAway: {name} is away from the game right now. The game is saved and will continue when they come back.
guessCharacter.pickSubtitle: The guesser will not see your choice until the round ends.
guessCharacter.waitingPick: {name} is choosing a character. You can go back to the chat — the game is saved.
guessCharacter.waitingGuess: {name} is guessing. Questions will appear below.
guessCharacter.yourTurn: Ask a question or try to guess.
guessCharacter.attemptsNote: A wrong guess costs one question.

puzzle.title: Puzzles
puzzle.rules: Build one picture together on a shared board. Drag a piece with a finger or mouse — near its place it snaps in, and correctly joined neighbours stick together as a group. A piece your partner is holding is highlighted in their colour and can't be taken. Pinch to zoom and use two fingers to move the board. You can leave and come back — the puzzle is kept.
